Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Zephyr Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 T or 3.0 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- a maximum spatial field gradient of 20 T/m.
- Use the body transmit coil.
- Any receive-only coil may be used.
1.5 T scanning conditions:
- whole-body averaged SAR of 2 W/kg or less.
- head averaged SAR of 0.1 W/kg.
- Scan for up to 20 minutes.
3 T scanning conditions:
- maximum B1+rms of 1.7 microtesla; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.2 W/kg.
- Maximum active scan time of 15 minutes.
Before scanning, set the device configuration: MRI mode ON.
Scan regions: Full body scanning is permitted (no exclusion zone).
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
